title: DEFINE step 3 PR 7: --litmus <n> on rcf define freeze
description: src/cli/freeze.js adds the --litmus <n> flag with usage help, parses it via parseLitmusFlag, and after the gate check (and any --ack folding) refuses (exit 4) and writes nothing when fewer than n distinct litmus readings exist at the current tree hash. --litmus-attested remains the default attestation path and is unchanged.
